entries.5c7fc4d8cd420235: Under its corporate philosophy, “YURTEC will cooperate in creating value that enriches people's hearts and contribute to the development of society,” it is advancing its long-term vision, the “2030 Vision,” and its “Medium-Term Management Plan (2024–2028).” Building on deepening its business in “Tohoku and Niigata,” its business area since its founding, it is expanding its business by focusing on four priority businesses: “Outside Tohoku and Niigata,” “Overseas Business,” “Renewable Energy-Related Construction,” and “Renovation Construction.” In October 2025, it revised upward the numerical targets of its medium-term management plan.
entries.5e31a61b8653d47a: The company and 16 consolidated subsidiaries, together with one other affiliated company, make up the group (as of March 31, 2026).
